user_problem: Browser agents re-pay the full exploration cost (browser actions, model calls, tokens, latency, flaky retries) on every run, even when a task is a repeat or near-repeat of a goal class some prior run already solved (login/form flows, pagination drills, navigation paths) with only rewording or parameter/entry-state shifts.

target_task_class.description: Goal-directed multi-step web tasks on small structured public practice/demo sites: authentication flows, iterated pagination to a target listing position, category/listing navigation and form submission with anchored completion predicates. Three preregistered regimes on matched knowledge bases. Navigation/pagination/form families run in Phase A; login-family rows enter at Phase B.

regimes.R1_repeat_reworded: same underlying goal, goal text paraphrased (paraphrases authored independently of the consumer model's family AND outside V31's closed synonym classes whenever feasible)
regimes.R2_near_repeat_shifted: same fragment classes, shifted entry state or shifted target parameter (e.g., different page depth, different account, different item)
regimes.R3_novel_control: genuinely new goals outside inherited coverage; SPIDER arm must degrade gracefully to exploration without losing to baseline

sites: optional additions from the already-used demo set (saucedemo.com, parabank) only if the affordance inventory proves two sites insufficient - disclosed in the beta prereg before outcomes
explicitly_out_of_scope: category-type goals as primary endpoints (known unsolved failure mode; tracked descriptively)
chains requiring >3 distinct stored fragments (Graph lane's graph-inheritance-scaling program territory; tracked descriptively)
any route/API-capture-replay or registry feature (Unbrowse-class claims are OFFICIAL_CLAIM vendor-run only; Intel cycle-2 reproduction pending)
capsule/resolver plumbing owned by Runtime until Runtime ships an accepted schema (consume it when it lands; do not fork it)

validated_building_blocks: Cumulative store: states/transitions/fragments with provenance + confidence fields; exact replay reached 0 novel actions on matched routes (Graph G-H1)
Blind content-addressed fragment retrieval with expected-UNKNOWN discipline; cold / verbatim-nearest-replay / single-shot-BFS baselines solved 0/3 composites (Graph G-H2)
Oracle-equalized iterative replay policy carries composed depth at tested depth; login procedure packaging residual value frag 16/16 rows vs graphiter 0/8 (Graph G-H3 E2, audit PASS after repair)
Multi-step login packaging = validated procedural ordering: frag 4/4 login-memory rows vs graphiter 0/4 (exploration-only) vs static edge-unit replay 0/4 with bounce pathology (Graph G-H4 R3)

V31 closed-class descriptor/query equipment adopted as standard equipment (Graph G-H4 program decision); used AS EQUIPMENT ONLY, applied identically in every SPIDER-arm condition including ablation variants, so it is never a differing variable between compared conditions - no quantitative retrieval-transfer claim is licensed (fresh instrument spent)

SGDR-style fused task-goal + current-state-summary candidate scoring for free-form goals (Intel cycle-1 clean-room reproduction; audit gate PASS run 32800296360; VALIDATED_USEFUL; claim tier ceiling PROOF_OF_CONCEPT): hard-slice correct@1 36/74 vs task-text-only 25/74 (11 paired wins / 0 reversals) under paraphrased goals + shifted entry contexts; wrong-context-summary fusion falls back to baseline level (24/74); converted into fewer novel exploration actions than task-only retrieval at equal-or-higher subgoal success in the NL-consumer regime (39 vs 42 literal; 36 vs 42 paraphrase). Validated configuration ONLY: lexical-hash embedder, deterministic contract-faithful summarizer, pool top-M=max(3k,20), greedy MMR lambda=0.7, alpha=0.4. BINDING LIMITS THAT TRAVEL: PoC tier; advantage exists vs task-only retrieval exactly and only in the natural-language-consumer regime (hand-authored exact signatures remain more action-efficient where they exist: 21 vs 39 novel on the literal slice); no login/pager addressing improvement claimed; tiny library/sites; GENERALIZATION language forbidden; WebArena headline numbers NOT reproduced and forbidden in any narrative. Clean-room lineage only (intel/experiments/sgdr_repro/); never copy CC BY-SA reference source.
assumptions_under_test: A1: inheritance benefit survives a real LLM consumer (all accepted evidence used scripted deterministic consumers). FIRST-ORDER unknown; gated explicitly by Phase-A smoke diagnostics before the confirmatory panel burns

A2: free-form natural-language goals are served END-TO-END by audited fused task+state-summary candidate scoring inside the product loop, without hand-authored goal signatures, measured strictly as end-to-end task outcomes. Made ATTRIBUTABLE by the new Phase-A retrieval diagnostic (stacked SGDR+V31 vs V31-only vs primitive scorer with a frozen named fallback ordering): an A2 LOSE must be attributable to mechanism vs assembly error
A3: packaged procedures (login-style fragments) deliver measurable savings over edge iteration AND over prompt-level trajectory memory with an LLM consumer (Phase B)

A4: savings are material in tokens/model-calls/wall-clock seconds (perf_counter instrumentation + provider usage accounting; first-ever cost/latency measurement of this stack; quoted both marginally and net of amortized store-build overhead)
A5: known failure modes (category goals, deep chains, cross-site) remain contained inside the declared scope with honest UNKNOWN reporting and zero fabricated successes

delta_pack.D3_silent_execution_semantics: PREREGISTER silent-execution semantics: inherited segments materialize deterministically under verifier guards; the LLM engages only at UNKNOWN/novelty boundaries; ALL verifier/guard/summarizer/retrieval costs count inside SPIDER totals. delta_pack.D4_small_n_and_replication_protections: Medians reported WITH paired per-row deltas and n/coverage; replication clause is CONJUNCTIVE (each deterministic pass individually meets all floors, not averages); comparator for the efficiency clauses is selected by a procedure frozen NOW (per regime: highest success rate; tie broken by lowest median tokens) - never chosen after outcomes; R3 non-degradation bound reported alongside WIN: SPIDER median token/action overhead on R3 <= +25% vs B0; a LOSE triggered ONLY by the wall-clock clause routes to the single sanctioned repair round rather than auto-kill (wall-clock has never once been measured validly on this stack; integer-ms flooring is a documented defect).
delta_pack.D5_contamination_controls: Producer/eval separation: evaluation tasks operationally disjoint from store-construction episodes (no shared goals, routes or anchors); paraphrase seeds held out from build runs and NOT drawn from V31's closed synonym classes; paraphrase authorship lineage recorded; trajectory pool for B1 built from an exploration corpus symmetric to SPIDER's store construction (same budget/provenance); retry policy identical and fully counted for every arm.
delta_pack.D6_amortization_accounting: Phase A additionally measures store-population cost, verification cost and one update/recovery cycle; report amortized per-task overhead and break-even N* (cumulative savings >= build+maintenance) alongside the marginal medians; every efficiency claim in any narrative states both views.
delta_pack.D7_implementation_hygiene: Byte-restoration ground truth = committed content-hashed LOCAL snapshot fixtures; live site appears only through the health gate; sanctioned form writes separated from leaks by a MECHANICAL allowlist specified at F2 (never rewritten after failures); every knob value hashed into the F1 manifest (alpha=0.4, lambda=0.7, M=max(3k,20) with k defined numerically, seeds, thresholds, summarizer pinned lockfile).

fairness_constraints: identical backbone model, decoding policy, budgets, observation format across agent arms
the machine-checkable acceptance/completion predicate is disclosed to ALL arms identically as part of the task definition
knowledge base byte-restored before every evaluation row against committed content-hashed fixtures; evaluation runs write nothing to the store
site-health gate per row; abort-and-rerun applies identically to both compared arms
paraphrase/goal authorship recorded; independent-of-consumer-family authorship preferred; paraphrases disjoint from V31 synonym classes
all SPIDER-arm retrieval/planning/summarization/verifier overhead counted inside SPIDER totals (no hidden subsidy)
comparator selection for efficiency clauses frozen pre-outcome (per regime: highest success; tie -> lowest median tokens)

primary_metrics: task success rate per regime and overall (anchored predicates; fabricated success = automatic failure event)
browser actions per task (novel vs reused split)
LLM model calls and total tokens (input+output) per task
wall-clock latency per task at perf_counter granularity
reused-action share of the action mix
retrieval diagnostic metrics in Phase A (retrieval@1 + UNKNOWN rate per scoring variant)
amortization view: store-population + verification + maintenance costs and break-even N* (reporting duty)
UNKNOWN/false-match discipline events (descriptive; false accepts are violations)

win_rule.preregistration_note: Director-mandated floor, carried VERBATIM through revisions 1-5; the Architect freeze must meet or exceed it in strictness. Tightenings added pre-outcome in rev 5 (conjunctive replication, frozen comparator selection, R3 overhead reporting bound, wall-clock repair routing) appear in .directed_pre_outcome_revision_v3.delta_pack.D4 and never weaken anything below.
WIN_if_all: success_SPIDER >= success_best_baseline - 0.10 absolute on the full panel including R3 control rows

on R1+R2 rows: median browser actions reduced >= 50% AND median total tokens reduced >= 40% AND median wall-clock reduced >= 30% versus the strongest baseline achieving comparable success (B1 if it beats B0; comparator chosen by the frozen pre-outcome selection procedure)
zero fabricated-success events in the SPIDER arm
results replicate across two deterministic passes where the environment is static (CONJUNCTIVE: each pass individually meets all floors)
LOSE_if_any: SPIDER arm fails > 25% of tasks solved by the best baseline
median reductions < 20% on R1+R2 versus the same comparator
win_rule.special_routing: If the ONLY failing WIN clause is the wall-clock reduction clause, the outcome routes to the single sanctioned preregistered repair round instead of auto-kill; a second consecutive wall-clock failure stands as LOSE.
win_rule.reporting_duties: Report all regimes and all baselines including losses AND the B3 parity check AND amortized break-even analysis; negative outcome is a valid product result and feeds the PH-1 disposition decision. An attributed LOSE (naming which of A1-A5 failed) is equally valuable evidence.

maximum_scope: Internal benchmark harness only. <=4 small public practice/demo sites; ~30-60 evaluation rows total across regimes plus Phase-A diagnostics and fixture checks; one backbone model family per beta version; read-only interactions except the demo sites' own intended forms; compute budget capped and logged; NO production deployment, NO public users, NO commercialization, NO external data sharing. Human authorization required for anything beyond this scope.
kill_condition: Beta stops and PH-1 returns to PROMISING-or-lower if: SPIDER arm loses cleanly under the LOSE rule after the single sanctioned repair round, OR
two consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID batches occur (infrastructure not ready), OR
a live-site health/integrity incident occurs (pause immediately, disclose, resume only with repaired gating)
A losing beta is useful evidence: its artifacts feed the PH-1 continue/repair/re-architecture/reject decision per the Product feedback rules.
